canonical_title: Competency: Definition, Types and Key Features

one_line_answer.text: Competency is measurable or observable knowledge, skills and attitude (KSA) for successful job performance.

cites.quote: Competencies refer to the measurable or observable knowledge, skills and attitude (KSAs), which are critical to successful job performance.

keywords.bn: যোগ্যতা: জ্ঞান, দক্ষতা ও মনোভাব একসাথে

bangla_explanation: Competency মানে শুধু হাতের skill নয়; knowledge, skill আর attitude তিনটাই লাগে (KSA)।
Skill হলো competency-র একটা অংশ মাত্র।
ভালো welder হলেই কেউ TVET trainer হতে পারে না; knowledge আর সঠিক attitude-ও লাগে।
Key features চারটা: কাজ করতে পারা, কেন-কীভাবে জানা, সমস্যা হলে কী করতে হবে জানা, আর safely কাজ করার সঠিক approach।

example.en: A good welder joins a TVET institute. He also needs knowledge and the right attitude to be a competent trainer.
example.bn: ভালো welder হলেই trainer হিসেবে competent নয়; পড়াশোনা/অভিজ্ঞতা আর ভালো আচরণও লাগবে।

mnemonic.text: KSA = Know it, Show it, Act right
mnemonic.explain_bn: Knowledge = জানা, Skill = করে দেখানো, Attitude = সঠিক আচরণ।

traps.text: Skill is a part of competency. Competency has three parameters: knowledge, skills and attitude.

cites.quote: Skill is a part of competency. Competency consists of three parameters (KSA) - Knowledge (K), Skills(S) and Attitude (A).

traps.text: Rating skills looks at practical abilities. Rating competency also needs knowledge and attitude.

cites.quote: While rating skills, you have to determine what abilities are required to perform a job
practically but while rating competency, you have to determine the set of abilities/
skills required along with the knowledge and attitude needed for the said job.

short.prompt: What are the key features of competency?
short.modelAnswer:
Competency is the measurable or observable knowledge, skills and attitude (KSA) for successful job performance. Key features of competency:
1. Being able to do the job
2. Knowing how and why things are done
3. Knowing what to do if things go wrong
4. Having the right approach to do a job properly and safely

keyPoints.text: Knowledge competencies: practical or theoretical understanding of subjects.

cites.quote: Knowledge Competencies - practical or theoretical understanding of subjects.

keyPoints.text: Skill competencies: natural or learned capacities to perform acts.

cites.quote: Skill Competencies - natural or learned capacities to perform acts.

keyPoints.text: Attitude competencies: patterns of action or conduct.

cites.quote: Attitude Competencies - patterns of action or conduct.

viva.prompt: Is a very good welder automatically competent to be a TVET trainer?

answer.text: No. He also needs adequate knowledge and the right attitude.

cites.quote: but s/he will not be competent to join a TVET Institute as TVET Teacher/Trainer unless s/he possesses
adequate education/ experience (Knowledge) and the right temperament/ behaviour (attitude).
